mapper.select: SELECT CAST(csc.config_id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(csc.coupon_id AS CHAR) AS couponId, gm.name AS couponName, csc.send_type AS sendType, COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(csc.rule_json, '$.sentCount')) AS UNSIGNED), 0) AS sentCount, csc.created_at AS createdAtValue, csc.status AS status FROM coupon_send_config csc JOIN goods_main gm ON gm.goods_id = csc.coupon_id AND gm.camp_id = csc.camp_id AND gm.goods_type = 'coupon' AND gm.is_deleted = 0 WHERE csc.camp_id = #{campId} ORDER BY csc.created_at DESC, csc.config_id DESC
